B is a little more informative and polished: it shows the year, says which cake each person is bringing and highlights the next Sunday. A adds a Reset button and shows a faint, barely visible disabled Swap on the past row. B's small footer note about example names is minor and doesn't clutter the page. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are very similar: both are dark, tidy one-screen rotas with five dated Sundays, a named person for each and clear outlined Swap buttons.
